sections.title: Featured Collection
sections.body: A selection of works that highlight key themes and projects within this branch. These pieces represent both personal milestones and defining creative moments across recent releases.

items.title: Decade Search
description: A four-month AI video experiment created to visually tell the story carried by the music.
The project explores how generated imagery can translate a long-form musical narrative into a connected visual experience.
about: Created over four months as an experiment in AI-assisted visual storytelling.
The video translates the song's decade-spanning narrative into a connected visual journey.

items.title: The Unreachable Flower
description: A symbolic visual interpretation built around imagery representing love, longing, mystery, and the unattainable.
The blue rose serves as the central symbol, connecting the song's emotional themes with ideas of uniqueness, dreams, and something just beyond reach.
about: Built around symbolic imagery chosen to express the song's meaning.
The blue rose represents love, mystery, dreams, and something beautiful that remains beyond reach.

items.title: The Parts You Don't See
description: A visual self-reflection exploring the different experiences, motivations, and characteristics that shape personal identity.
Each section pairs the music with imagery reflecting another part of the person behind what others normally see.
about: A visual self-reflection exploring the different parts of personal identity.
Each section uses imagery reflecting the experiences, motivations, and characteristics explored by the song.

sections.title: Music Videos
body: Music videos bring Themadhood's original music into a visual format, combining each song with imagery designed to complement its sound, story, and atmosphere.
Videos range from narrative-driven pieces to simpler visual productions, with each created around the needs and style of the individual song.

items.title: Decade Search
items.about: An experimental AI-assisted music video developed over four months to visually translate the song's decade-spanning story.
items.description: Created over the course of four months, Decade Search served as an extended experiment in using AI-generated visuals for narrative storytelling. The video follows the story carried by the music, transforming its progression, memories, and emotional moments into a visual interpretation designed to accompany the song from beginning to end.

items.title: Second Meeting
items.about: An experimental AI-assisted music video exploring visual contrast as a way of interpreting the song.
items.description: Second Meeting continued the experimentation with AI-generated music videos, with a greater emphasis on contrasting imagery, moods, and visual ideas. Rather than attempting to illustrate every lyric literally, the video uses those contrasts to create a visual interpretation of the emotions and changing perspectives within the song.

items.title: The Unreachable Flower
items.about: A symbolic music video using carefully selected imagery to express the song's themes of love, longing, and the unattainable.
items.description: The video's imagery was selected for its symbolic meaning, allowing different visual elements to communicate the themes of the song in their own ways. The rose represents love, while its blue color introduces ideas of mystery, uniqueness, dreams, and something beautiful that remains beyond reach. Together, these elements create a visual interpretation of the song rather than a literal retelling of it.

items.title: Fortress Of My Mind
items.about: An AI-generated interpretation of the song created almost entirely through a dedicated music video generation system.
items.description: Fortress Of My Mind was produced as an experiment with a dedicated AI music video generator. The finished video came from the second generation attempt and developed differently from the original vision for the project. While the result was unexpected, the generated imagery ultimately created its own interpretation of the song and became a successful experiment in allowing the tool greater creative control.

items.title: Two Months And A Message
items.about: A simple audio-visual presentation designed to give the song a visual presence without creating a traditional narrative music video.
items.description: Rather than telling a separate visual story, Two Months And A Message uses a restrained audio-visual presentation that keeps the music at the center of the experience. The visuals serve primarily as a companion to the track, providing movement and atmosphere without competing with the song's narrative.
